correction.previous_assumption: A separate global inode directory or a completed-FSTAT adoption command was needed to avoid a second registration FSTAT.
correction.finding: The existing six-role outer already owns the device/inode directory and carries the one actual registration FSTAT request/result into the existing DB-node register continuation. That prior assumption is withdrawn.
correction.scope: This concerns the registration FSTAT only. SQLite verifyDbFile may subsequently issue additional FSTAT/STAT warnings; it is not a claim that complete unixOpen performs just one stat syscall.

source_evidence.detail: j_pre_stat validates the actual gateway stat result, selects an existing live node by device/inode or creates a node, and saves the exact 256-byte actual FS request plus complete result payload in a private source blob.

Registration saves the pre-FSTAT FS call/syscall watermarks at workspace offsets 336/344. A new DB node starts from these previous watermarks, while the outer accepts the completed current DMS/FS receipt.

The DB register request is sent to the same native child. At its exact first FSTAT pending action, the outer checks command/stage/op/token/zero arguments, builds an ACK with the saved original request/result, consumes the saved blob, and resumes the DB child. This branch does not issue another FS gateway action.

The actual-child channel is correlated to the pending source bytes, role/node/generation/action and native workspace; stat duplicate fields are cross-checked. Completion synchronizes the issued file row and live reference count.

provenance_boundary: These are private fixed-carrier-issued channels. Byte headers/nonces by themselves are not external authentication, and this static review does not add execution counts.

adopt_r4.interpretation: A more explicit completed-receipt component interface. It is not a fix for an observed duplicate syscall in the current six-role outer and is not used to replace current physical qualification.

next_required_work: Extend the existing outer with source-bound findReusableFd/TAKE_UNUSED selection and deferred-token consumption.
Join complete unixOpen creation modes, read-only fallback and actual FS7 primitives while preserving error and side-effect order.
Keep the complete physical gates, ordinary Store/31-SQL and migration work separate from component passes.
